notes.title: 2.0.1.1a Hotfix for AP
notes.content: - Fixed a bug that did not consider repeat achievements when calculating AP. Retroactively awards the missing points.

notes.title: 2.0.1.1 Music update, UI cleanup
notes.content:
UI:

- Cleaned up achievements panel some more, added spent AP value.

Music:

- Added a new track by Ed Tremblay for Combat Training.
- improved the music timing at the beginning of stages.
- Fixed the wrong music playing sometimes in the first stages of some loops in replays.

Misc:

- Removed debug info that was briefly displaying during stage loading.
- Made the title scroll even slower :D
- Various small bug fixes.

notes.title: 2.0.1.0 Localization and saving fixes, small improvements
notes.content:
Gameplay/Graphics:

- Added some different VFX to bottom portals (you will know when you see them) to make them stand out from the regular portals.
- Improved contrast/visibility on corrupted projectiles and AOEs.

Localization:

- Fixed some formatting issues.
- Adapted the title scroll and ending texts speeds to the length of the localized texts and generally made them slower.
- Updated some texts.

UI:

- Removed some superfluous buttons that snuck into the leaderboard entry details.
- Improved color contrast/readability on achievements.
- Fixed not being able to close windows when a scrollbar is selected.

Saving:

- Added triggering a save immediately after unlocking a new mode, added some safeguards against parallel file access.

Misc:

- Preparing some backend systems for merging with the old leaderboards on itch.
